scholarships.name: First Graduate Scholarship
scholarships.description: Encourages first generation learners by providing financial aid to pursue higher education. This scheme aims to support students whose parents/guardians have no formal education to pursue undergraduate and diploma courses.
scholarships.eligibility: First generation learners from economically weaker sections
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Register on TN Scholarships portal
2. Fill application form with personal and academic details
3. Upload required documents
4. Submit application before deadline
5. Verification of documents conducted by authorities
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: May 1 | Last Date: July 31 | Results: October 15
scholarships.whoShouldApply: First generation college students whose parents are not educated

scholarships.name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme
scholarships.description: A flagship initiative of Tamil Nadu government to provide monthly financial assistance to girl students, encouraging their education and reducing gender-based educational gaps. The scheme supports girls from all socioeconomic backgrounds in government institutions.
scholarships.eligibility: Girls studying in TN government schools and colleges (Standard VI onwards)
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Apply through your school/college administration
2. Submit required documents to the principal
3. Institutional verification process
4. Forwarding to district authorities
5. Monthly disbursement through bank account
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: June 1 | Regular: August 15 | Disbursement: Monthly
scholarships.whoShouldApply: Girl students from government schools pursuing UG studies, all streams

scholarships.name: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme
scholarships.description: A transformative initiative providing monthly financial support to boy students from government institutions, promoting inclusive education and empowering male learners from all backgrounds.
scholarships.eligibility: Boys studying in TN government schools and colleges (Standard VI onwards)
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Apply through your school/college administration
2. Submit required documents to the principal
3. Institutional verification process
4. Forwarding to district authorities
5. Monthly disbursement through bank account
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: June 1 | Regular: August 15 | Disbursement: Monthly
scholarships.whoShouldApply: Boy students from government schools pursuing UG studies

scholarships.name: BC/MBC Scholarship
scholarships.description: Comprehensive financial assistance scheme for Backward and Most Backward Caste students pursuing professional and general degree courses.
scholarships.eligibility: Backward and Most Backward Caste students with annual family income =6 LPA
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Apply online on TN Scholarships portal
2. Enter academic and caste details
3. Upload caste certificate and income certificate
4. Document verification by college authorities
5. Final approval and fund disbursement
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: June 1 | Last Date: July 31 | Verification: August-September | Disbursal: October
scholarships.whoShouldApply: BC/MBC students pursuing professional and general degree courses with merit-based selection

scholarships.name: SC/ST Scholarship
scholarships.description: A comprehensive scholarship support program for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students pursuing any stream of higher education.
scholarships.eligibility: Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students pursuing higher education
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Apply through TN Scholarships portal
2. Fill detailed application form
3. Upload all required certificates
4. College-level verification
5. Directorate-level approval and disbursement
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: June 1 | Last Date: July 31 | Verification: August | Results: September 15
scholarships.whoShouldApply: SC/ST students pursuing any stream of higher education with merit consideration

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship
scholarships.description: A prestigious national scholarship program designed to encourage girl students to pursue engineering and technology education.
scholarships.eligibility: Girl students in AICTE-approved technical institutions with annual family income =8 LPA
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Apply on AICTE Pragati portal
2. Verify JEE/GATE scores and qualification
3. Submit income certificate
4. College verification through AICTE dashboard
5. Direct bank account transfer of funds
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: July 1 | Last Date: December 31 | Verification: January-March | Disbursal: April
scholarships.whoShouldApply: Girl students pursuing engineering and technology courses in AICTE-approved institutions

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scholarship
scholarships.description: A centrally-sponsored merit-based scholarship scheme by the Government of India for talented students from economically weaker backgrounds.
scholarships.eligibility: Meritorious students with =80% in 12th and annual family income =3 LPA
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Register on National Scholarships Portal (NSP)
2. Apply for Central Sector Scholarship
3. Upload academic and income documents
4. College verification through NSP
5. Final approval by authorities
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: June 1 | Last Date: September 15 | College Verification: October | Results: November 15
scholarships.whoShouldApply: Merit-based selection for deserving students from low-income families

scholarships.name: NSP Scholarships
scholarships.description: The National Scholarship Portal is a comprehensive platform offering multiple scholarship schemes with varying criteria.
scholarships.eligibility: Varies by scheme (Merit, Needs-based, Special categories)
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Visit NSP website
2. Register as new applicant
3. Browse available scholarships
4. Apply for eligible schemes
5. Upload required documents
6. Track application status on dashboard
scholarships.importantDates: Applications Open: June 1 | Deadline: October 31 | Verification: November-December | Results: January 15
scholarships.whoShouldApply: Students from government schools pursuing higher education across all streams

scholarships.name: Agaram Foundation Support
scholarships.description: A renowned NGO providing comprehensive support including scholarships and skill development training for underprivileged students.
scholarships.eligibility: Students from underprivileged background interested in skill development, annual income <?3 LPA
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Visit Agaram Foundation office or website
2. Fill admission application form
3. Attend counseling session
4. Document verification
5. Selection based on need assessment
6. Course enrollment and stipend distribution
scholarships.importantDates: Applications: Year-round | Intakes: January, April, July, October | Program Duration: 6-12 months
scholarships.whoShouldApply: Students from marginalized communities seeking skill and career development with placement support

scholarships.name: Anna University Merit Scholarship
scholarships.description: A prestigious merit-based scholarship offered by Anna University to recognize and support exceptional engineering students in affiliated colleges.
scholarships.eligibility: Top performing students in Anna University affiliated colleges with CGPA =8.0
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Apply through college principal's office
2. Submit JEE score and CGPA details
3. College validates academic records
4. Forward to Anna University
5. Final approval based on merit ranking
6. Semester-wise disbursement through bank
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: Semester-wise in June & December | Verification: 1 month | Disbursal: Next semester
scholarships.whoShouldApply: High scorers in Anna University engineering colleges with consistent performance

scholarships.name: Post Matric Scholarship
scholarships.description: A specialized post-matric scholarship scheme specifically designed to support SC/ST students pursuing higher education after 12th standard.
scholarships.eligibility: SC/ST students pursuing studies after 12th with no upper age limit
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Apply online on TN Scholarships portal
2. Fill detailed academic information
3. Upload caste and income certificates
4. College-level verification
5. Approval and fund disbursement
6. Annual renewal based on continuation
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: June 1 | Last Date: August 31 | Verification: September | Results: October 1
scholarships.whoShouldApply: SC/ST students pursuing degree and diploma courses with merit consideration

scholarships.name: Polytechnic Merit Scholarship
scholarships.description: A merit-based scholarship program supporting talented diploma students pursuing technical education in polytechnic institutes.
scholarships.eligibility: Merit-based for diploma students in Tamil Nadu polytechnic colleges with CGPA =7.5
scholarships.applicationProcess:
1. Apply through college principal
2. Submit cut-off mark certificate
3. College verifies academic merit
4. Selection based on merit ranking
5. Government approval
6. Direct fund transfer to college account
scholarships.importantDates: Application Opens: May 15 | Last Date: July 15 | Verification: July 20-30 | Approval: August 5
scholarships.whoShouldApply: High-scoring students in polytechnic institutes pursuing technical diploma courses
